salesforce-app-manager.alt: Salesforce Setup App Manager with a New Connected App button highlighted in the top-right corner
salesforce-app-manager.caption: Setup → App Manager → New Connected App.

salesforce-oauth-settings.alt: Salesforce New Connected App OAuth settings showing Enable OAuth Settings ticked, the QVO Callback URL filled in, and the api and refresh_token/offline_access scopes selected
salesforce-oauth-settings.caption: Enable OAuth, paste the Callback URL, and add the api + refresh_token/offline_access scopes.

salesforce-consumer-details.alt: Salesforce Consumer Details page showing Consumer Key and Consumer Secret values with Copy buttons
salesforce-consumer-details.caption: Manage Consumer Details — copy the Consumer Key (Client ID) and Consumer Secret.

salesforce-sandbox-toggle.alt: QVO Salesforce connector card with a Login host selector showing Production and Sandbox options, and a Sign in with Salesforce button
salesforce-sandbox-toggle.caption: Pick Production or Sandbox to match your org type before signing in.

salesforce-task-on-contact.alt: Salesforce Contact record with a QVO Voice Agent Call activity logged on the Activity timeline including a transcript snippet and link
salesforce-task-on-contact.caption: A Task with the AI summary appears on the matching Contact or Lead activity timeline.

outlook-app-registration.alt: Microsoft Entra Register an application page with the Name field set to QVO Voice Agent, Single tenant selected, and a Web Redirect URI containing the QVO callback
outlook-app-registration.caption: Pick Single tenant (or Multi-tenant), then paste the QVO callback as the Web Redirect URI.

outlook-overview-ids.alt: Microsoft Entra app Overview page with Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID highlighted with copy buttons
outlook-overview-ids.caption: Copy Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID from the Overview page.

outlook-client-secret.alt: Microsoft Entra Certificates & secrets tab with a newly generated client secret and the Value column highlighted next to a Copy button
outlook-client-secret.caption: Copy the Value column NOW — it is masked after you leave the page.

outlook-api-permissions.alt: Microsoft Entra API permissions panel showing the five required Microsoft Graph delegated permissions ticked plus a Grant admin consent button
outlook-api-permissions.caption: Add the five Graph permissions, then click Grant admin consent.

outlook-qvo-calendar-pick.alt: QVO Outlook Calendar integration card showing Connected status with a dropdown to pick which calendar QVO may book on
outlook-qvo-calendar-pick.caption: After OAuth returns, pick the calendar QVO should write events to.

hubspot-create-app.alt: HubSpot Developers Manage apps page with a Create app button highlighted in the top-right
hubspot-create-app.caption: Developer hub → Manage apps → Create app.

hubspot-oauth-redirect.alt: HubSpot app Auth tab showing Client ID, Client secret, and the Redirect URLs field highlighted with the QVO callback URL
hubspot-oauth-redirect.caption: Paste the QVO callback URL into the Auth tab's Redirect URLs field.

hubspot-scopes.alt: HubSpot scopes panel with the five required scopes ticked: contacts read/write, deals read/write, and timeline
hubspot-scopes.caption: Tick exactly the five scopes QVO needs.

hubspot-qvo-connect.alt: QVO HubSpot connector card with two options: Sign in with HubSpot (OAuth) on the left and a paste-an-access-token form on the right
hubspot-qvo-connect.caption: QVO → Integrations → HubSpot offers OAuth (recommended) or an access token.

hubspot-private-app.alt: HubSpot private app Auth tab showing the access token starting with pat- highlighted next to a Copy button
hubspot-private-app.caption: Private app access tokens begin with pat- and never expire — rotate manually.

google-enable-api.alt: Google Cloud Console API library page for Google Calendar API with the ENABLE button highlighted
google-enable-api.caption: Library → Google Calendar API → Enable.

google-oauth-consent.alt: Google OAuth consent screen with Internal user-type selected and the two calendar scopes ticked
google-oauth-consent.caption: Pick Internal where possible, then add the two calendar scopes.

google-credentials.alt: Google Cloud Create OAuth client ID form with Application type set to Web application and the QVO redirect URI in Authorized redirect URIs
google-credentials.caption: Use Web application + the QVO callback URL — no trailing slash.

google-client-secret.alt: Google Cloud OAuth client created modal showing the Client ID and Client secret values with copy buttons
google-client-secret.caption: Copy both Client ID and Client secret immediately — the secret is only shown once.

google-qvo-calendar-picker.alt: QVO Google Calendar connector card showing the connected account, calendar picker, timezone, and buffer-time settings
google-qvo-calendar-picker.caption: Pick the calendar, timezone, and buffer times in the QVO connector card.

slack-create-app.alt: Slack Create an app dialog with the From scratch option selected and an app-name field reading QVO
slack-create-app.caption: Pick "From scratch" and name the app QVO.

slack-bot-scopes.alt: Slack OAuth & Permissions page with Bot Token Scopes chat:write, channels:read, and groups:read ticked
slack-bot-scopes.caption: Add the three Bot Token Scopes — chat:write, channels:read, groups:read.

slack-redirect-urls.alt: Slack Redirect URLs section with the QVO callback URL added and a Save URLs button highlighted
slack-redirect-urls.caption: Click Save URLs — the URL is not active until saved.

slack-app-credentials.alt: Slack Basic Information App Credentials panel with Client ID and Client Secret fields highlighted
slack-app-credentials.caption: Copy Client ID and Client Secret from the Basic Information page.

slack-channel-id.alt: Slack channel About panel showing the Channel ID C091ABCD234 with a Copy button next to it
slack-channel-id.caption: Channel ID lives at the bottom of the channel About panel — click Copy.

pipedrive-create-app.alt: Pipedrive Developer Hub Create a new app dialog with Public app selected and an app name field reading QVO Voice Agent
pipedrive-create-app.caption: Pick Public app for multi-tenant or Private app for one company.

pipedrive-callback-url.alt: Pipedrive OAuth & access page with the Callback URL field highlighted containing the QVO callback
pipedrive-callback-url.caption: Paste the QVO callback URL into the Callback URL field.

pipedrive-scopes.alt: Pipedrive Scopes & permissions panel with contacts:full, deals:full, activities:full, and users:read ticked
pipedrive-scopes.caption: Tick exactly these four scopes — QVO needs nothing else.

pipedrive-qvo-connect.alt: QVO Pipedrive connector card with two options: Sign in with Pipedrive on the left and a personal API token form on the right
pipedrive-qvo-connect.caption: OAuth on the left, personal API token on the right.

pipedrive-personal-token.alt: Pipedrive Settings Personal preferences API page with the personal API token highlighted next to a Copy button and a company domain field
pipedrive-personal-token.caption: Copy the personal API token plus your company domain (yourcompany).

quickbooks-create-app.alt: Intuit Developer Create an app dialog with QuickBooks Online + Payments selected and an app name field reading QVO Voice Agent
quickbooks-create-app.caption: My Apps → Create an app → QuickBooks Online + Payments.

quickbooks-keys-environment.alt: Intuit Developer Keys & OAuth tab with the Development environment selected, Client ID and Client Secret shown, and the QVO redirect URI added
quickbooks-keys-environment.caption: Pick the environment first — keys are different for Development vs Production.

quickbooks-scopes.alt: Intuit Developer scopes page with com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting ticked and other scopes left unticked
quickbooks-scopes.caption: com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting is the only scope QVO needs.

quickbooks-realm-pick.alt: Intuit Authorize QVO modal with a Choose a company list showing two QuickBooks realms and the production company selected
quickbooks-realm-pick.caption: Pick the realm (company) — QVO captures the Realm ID from the callback.

quickbooks-qvo-invoice-config.alt: QVO QuickBooks connector card showing the connected realm, Invoice Item ID, item description, default invoice amount, and a Sync now button
quickbooks-qvo-invoice-config.caption: Set Invoice Item ID and default amount, then click Sync now.
